label: Date of surgery
notes: Not in any checked report. Import as YYYY-MM-DD.

label: Total number of operated lesions
notes: Specimen scope. Not the number of drawing marks.

label: Lymphadenectomy
notes: Not in any checked report. Drives the node fields.

label: Surgeon query
notes: Value list is a server-side SQL query; raw values not inspected.

label: Histological finding
notes: Only free-text field in the two surgery instruments. Patient-linked text.

label: pT
notes: Optional in REDCap.

label: pN
notes: Default pN0 applies in the web form only, not on import.

label: pM
notes: Default pMX applies in the web form only.

label: Number of lymph nodes
notes: Required only when lymphadenectomy = Performed.

label: R- classification (resection margin)
choices: 1=R0 No residual tumor | 2=R1 Microscopic residual tumor | 3=R2 Macroscopic residual tumor | 4=RX Cannot be assessed

label: L-invasion
choices: 1=L0 No lymphatic invasion | 2=L1 Lymphatic invasion present | 3=LX Cannot be evaluated

label: Vascular invasion
choices: 1=V0 No venous invasion | 2=V1 Microscopic venous invasion | 3=V2 Macroscopic venous invasion | 4=VX Cannot be evaluated

label: Grade group, ISUP
notes: Specimen scope. The lesion instrument has no grade-group field.

label: Definitive histology (ICD-O)
choices: 1=Carcinoma/Epithelial tumor | 2=Neuroendocrine tumor | 3=Sarcoma / mesenchymal tumor | 4=Hematolymphoid tumor | 5=Metastasis | 6=Other malignant tumors

label: Definitive postoperational histology (ICD-O) - specification
notes: Stored value format (code only or code + label) not verified.

label: Form status
notes: Suggest 1 (Unverified) for machine-drafted rows until a doctor confirms.

label: All segments affected
default_annotation: @IF clears it when a subset is chosen
notes: Web-form shortcut that checks 40 sectors (not urethra). On import write the sectors explicitly.

label: Prostate regions (41 columns)
type: checkbox, hidden, shown as image map
notes: 1 = sector affected, 0 = not. One lesion instance holds one set of sectors.

label: Type of histology
notes: 'Benign' exists: open question whether non-tumour marks such as inflammation get an instance.

label: X-dimension of the lesion [mm]
notes: Axes are not defined in the form; the report often does not name them either.

label: Extraprostatic extension
notes: Required. 'Not specified' is the only way to say not reported.

label: Segments affected (calc)
notes: sum of 40 sector checkboxes + ((all_sgm+1)*100). Not in the import template.

label: Record ID
notes: Format seen: CMP- plus 7 digits. How new IDs are issued was not checked.

label: Birth certificate number (rodne cislo)
notes: Format without the slash. dob_* fields are computed from it.

label: Patient ID (CLADE IS)
notes: Probably the code shown in brackets next to the record ID (not confirmed).
